  • Classes
    Class
    Description
    EndScreen
    Abstract class serving as an abstract base class for game-over screens WinScreen,EndScreen.
    Instructions
    Class representing the instructions screen in the game.
    LoseScreen
    Abstract class representing the screen displayed when the player loses the game that is extended based on reason for loss by either LoseScreenConcord or LoseScreenScore.
    LoseScreenConcord
    Class representing the screen displayed when the player loses due to being caught by the Concord Officer.
    LoseScreenScore
    Class representing the screen displayed when the player loses due to their score becoming negative.
    MainMenu
    Class representing the Main Menu screen in the game.
    Screen
    Abstract class representing a screen in the game that is extended by {MainMenu}, Instructions, and EndScreen.
    WinScreen
    Class representing the screen displayed when the player wins the game.
